header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: This Petition was filed in year 2024 and was lastly fixed in court on 09-09-2024. Thereafter, no effort was made by the petitioner to proceed with the instant Petition and is pending without any progress; which reflects that petitioner and his counsel have lost interest to pursue instant petition, therefore, same stands dismissed for non-prosecution.
